app.name: Alert feed
app.summary: Home Assistant's notifications on a tile, newest first. Tap one to read it or dismiss it; a new one can wake the screen.
app.tile_example: 3 alerts: Disk 4 is hot, UPS on battery
app.setting_wake_hint: A notification Home Assistant did not have a moment ago lights the screen and shows it in a popup. Off until you turn it on. Screens that were off when it arrived show it in the feed only.
